packageRules.description: Deny-list compromised axios versions (supply chain attack 2026-03-31)
Automerge low-risk updates. Majors are opened as usual and left for a human. stabilityDays and internalChecksFilter above still apply, so nothing merges before it has aged and its checks are green.

Mark majors so machinery downstream can tell them apart. The rule above already withholds automerge from them, but that is a decision only Renovate knows about: nothing on the pull request says which update type it carries, and the auto-merge workflow in netresearch/.github consequently merged majors too, overriding this policy. The label makes the distinction visible to anything that reads the pull request.
